description: Project capital growth from reinvesting perpetual futures funding income (compounding carry). Edge cases: initialCapital above zero; fundingRatePct in percent per interval (0.01 is 0.01%), either sign; intervalHours a whole number that divides 24 (1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12 or 24, default 8); durationDays above zero and at most 3650; reinvestPct 0 to 100 (default 100); a result too large to represent is an error. Assumes the rate stays constant. Not covered: a changing rate, fees, taxes, and the capital limits a venue may set. Use when user asks "how much will I make compounding 0.01% funding for 90 days?" or "what's my APY on this carry position?". Funding received is split by reinvestPct (the rest is withdrawn and still counts as earned); funding paid comes out of capital in full, and the capital never goes below 0. Returns: finalCapital, totalWithdrawn, endValue, totalEarned, totalEarnedPct, annualizedAPY, dailyEarnings, snapshots.

durationDays.description: Number of days to project, up to 3650

fundingRatePct.description: Funding rate per interval in PERCENT: 0.01 means 0.01%, so a quoted 0.0125% is 0.0125, never 0.000125

intervalHours.description: Hours between funding payments, the period fundingRatePct covers, a whole number of hours that divides 24. Default 8; 1 on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Kraken and Backpack (per-hour rates); 4 or 2 on some symbols.

reinvestPct.description: Percentage of funding received that is reinvested each interval, 0-100 (the rest is withdrawn and counts as earned; funding paid always comes out of capital). 100 = full compounding. Default 100.
